from build123d import *
import math

def build(params):
    W = params["width"]
    bd = params["base_depth"]; bt = params["base_thickness"]
    ang = params["angle"]; tilt = 90.0 - ang
    rl = params["rest_length"]; rt = params["rest_thickness"]
    lh = params["lip_height"]; lt = params["lip_thickness"]
    seat = params["seat_depth"]; rib_t = params["rib_thickness"]

    base = Box(bd, W, bt, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    lip = Box(lt, W, bt + lh, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    x0 = lt + seat
    rest = Pos(x0, 0, bt) * Rot(0, tilt, 0) * Box(rt, W, rl, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    s, c = math.sin(math.radians(tilt)), math.cos(math.radians(tilt))
    zg = bt + params["rib_height_ratio"] * rl * c
    xg = x0 + rt * c + (zg - bt) * math.tan(math.radians(tilt)) - 1.0
    xb0 = x0 + rt / c - 1.0
    tri = Polygon((xb0, bt - 1.0), (bd - params["rib_inset"], bt - 1.0), (xg, zg), align=None)
    rib = Pos(0, rib_t / 2, 0) * extrude(Plane.XZ * tri, rib_t)

    stand = base + lip + rest + rib
    return {
        "parts": {"stand": stand},
        "features": [
            {"tag": "stand", "part": "stand", "tools": [base]},
            {"tag": "front_lip", "part": "stand", "tools": [lip]},
            {"tag": "back_rest", "part": "stand", "tools": [rest]},
            {"tag": "support_rib", "part": "stand", "tools": [rib]},
        ],
        "materials": {"stand": "molded ABS"},
    }
